## Luna JSONL schema

One line per blind_id:

```json
{
  "blind_id": "B000001",
  "codable": true,
  "truncated_or_malformed": false,
  "protagonist_position": {"code":"castaway|keeper_host|wanderer|witness|other_none","evidence":"...","confidence":"solid|stretch|unclear"},
  "belonging_source": {"code":"external_rescue_beam|self_constructed|mutual|absent_unclear","evidence":"...","confidence":"solid|stretch|unclear"},
  "distance": {"code":["physical|temporal|interpersonal|epistemic|none_unclear"],"evidence":"...","confidence":"solid|stretch|unclear"},
  "transmission": {"code":["light|sound|text_object|food_care|movement_crossing|ritual_repetition|none_other"],"evidence":"...","confidence":"solid|stretch|unclear"},
  "response_certainty": {"code":"confirmed|delayed|ambiguous|unanswered|not_applicable","evidence":"...","confidence":"solid|stretch|unclear"},
  "ending_operation": {"code":"rescue|return|recognition|invitation|stewardship|transformation|unresolved|other","evidence":"...","confidence":"solid|stretch|unclear"},

  "notes":"maximum one sentence"
```

## Definitions Luna should receive

RELATIONAL RECURRENCE = an action/signal/ritual/maintenance behavior repeated across absence or separation so continuity becomes perceptible. It does not require lighthouse, timer, heartbeat, echo or literal signal vocabulary.

ATTACHMENT DIRECTION:
- receiver_to_signal: a figure relies on an external recurring source for orientation/belonging;
- keeper_to_receiver: a figure persists in maintaining/sending despite uncertain reception;
- mutual: repeated exchange sustains both sides;
- self_stabilizing: repetition primarily maintains the actor/system itself;
- none_unclear: unsupported.

Code only textual evidence. Do not infer model psychology, training causes, consciousness or collapse.
